user.description: Choose the projector to set up.

data_description.address: Projectors within Bluetooth range that are not set up yet.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description:
Home Assistant will register itself with the projector as a controller, the same way the smartphone app does.

1. Make sure the projector is switched on (projecting or in standby) and within range of a Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth proxy.
2. In the smartphone app, check that **Settings → Network → Restrict adding smartphones** is off.
3. Submit to pair. Home Assistant will appear as "Home Assistant" under **Smartphones added**. Pairing can take up to a minute.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair {name} again
reauth_confirm.description: The projector no longer accepts commands from Home Assistant, for example because it was removed from **Smartphones added** or the projector was reset. Make sure the projector is on and **Restrict adding smartphones** is off, then submit to pair again.

error.device_not_found: The projector is not in Bluetooth range. Switch it on and move it closer to a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
error.cannot_connect: Could not communicate with the projector over Bluetooth ({error}). Close the smartphone app, make sure the projector is on and near the Bluetooth adapter or proxy, and try again. Details are in the Home Assistant log.
error.pairing_failed: The projector did not accept pairing ({error}). Check that "Restrict adding smartphones" is off and try again.

remove_smartphone.name: Remove smartphone
remove_smartphone.description: Removes a smartphone from the projector's "Smartphones added" list, like "Delete smartphone" in the smartphone app. To control the projector again, it has to be paired again.

device_id.name: Projector
device_id.description: The projector whose list of smartphones to change.

smartphone_id.name: Smartphone ID
smartphone_id.description: The smartphone's ID, from the smartphone_ids attribute of the projector's Smartphones added sensor.

block_smartphone.name: Block smartphone
block_smartphone.description: Stops a smartphone in the projector's "Smartphones added" list from controlling it, like "Deny" in the smartphone app. The smartphone stays in the list.

device_id.name: Projector
device_id.description: The projector whose list of smartphones to change.

smartphone_id.name: Smartphone ID
smartphone_id.description: The smartphone's ID, from the smartphone_ids attribute of the projector's Smartphones added sensor.

allow_smartphone.name: Allow smartphone
allow_smartphone.description: Lets a blocked smartphone in the projector's "Smartphones added" list control it again, like "Allow" in the smartphone app.

device_id.description: The projector whose list of smartphones to change.

projector_stuck.title: {name} does not respond
projector_stuck.description: Every request to the projector times out, usually because its internal link is stuck. Press the recessed **RESET** button next to the DC IN jack; settings and pairings survive. This issue goes away once the projector responds again.
